marks.gloss_en: מאי קראה -- כי יסכר פי דוברי שקר: the stopping (yisacher) of the liars' mouth is askara for slander
R' Elazar b'R' Yosei: [askara comes] on account of slander
תא שמע: in the vineyard at Yavne R' Elazar b'R' Yosei gave untithed food as askara's cause -- שמע מינה אף על לשון הרע נמי קאמר (33b.4)
דברים טמאים סלקא דעתך? -- could it enter your mind [that it is] impure things? (the stam then rereads: אלא דברים שאינן מתוקנים -- p_ochlin_eino_metukanim, reported as his)
alternative 1: R' Elazar b'R' Yosei said askara comes for slander [only]
מאי קראה -- אם לא תדעי לך... ורעי את גדיותיך על משכנות הרועים
ואמרינן: גדיים הממושכנין על הרועים -- the kids are taken in pledge for the shepherds
התם כדרבי גוריון -- there, as R' Guryon: when there are no righteous in the generation, school children are seized for the generation (= p_guryon_tinokot_nitpasim)
R' Guryon: when there are righteous in the generation, the righteous are seized for the generation
דכתיב: ויבא יעקב שלם... ויחן את פני העיר -- Jacob, come through whole, graced the city
RSBY: since a miracle happened [to me], I will go and repair something
נשים יוכיחו! -- women [who are not obligated in Torah study and yet suffer askara] will prove otherwise
שמבטלות את בעליהן -- they keep their husbands from Torah
גוים יוכיחו! -- gentiles will prove otherwise
שמבטלין את ישראל -- they keep Israel from Torah
תינוקות יוכיחו! -- small children will prove otherwise
שמבטלין את אביהן -- they keep their fathers from Torah
תינוקות של בית רבן יוכיחו! -- school children [who do study Torah] will prove otherwise
R' Yehuda, R' Yosei and R' Shimon were sitting, and Yehuda ben Gerim sat by them
he and his son went and hid in the study hall; every day his wife brought them bread and a jug of water and they ate
RSBY and his son, seeing men ploughing and sowing: they abandon eternal life and occupy themselves with temporal life
at dusk on Shabbat eve they saw an old man holding two bundles of myrtle and running at twilight
R' Pinchas ben Yair, weeping over the cracks in RSBY's skin: woe is me that I have seen you so
